method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: get_audio_track
tools.description: Get a song performance with audio URL. triggers: 'play [song]', 'random track', 'listen to', 'surprise me', or when user selects a performance from get_song results. params: random=true for random; slug='YYYY-MM-DD/track-slug' for specific. display: Link to track web URL (use 'url', not 'mp3_url'). The web page provides artwork, context, and navigation.

random.description: Set to true for a random audio track

outputSchema.description: Audio track widget data with playback URLs, navigation, and adjacent shows

show.description: Full show data including all playable tracks

tools.name: get_playlist
tools.description: Get a playlist with track listing, show dates, and durations. display: Link playlist name to playlist URL, track titles to track web URLs (use 'url', not 'mp3_url'). Format dates as 'Jul 4, 2023'. Show max 10 tracks. Example: | [Tweezer](track_url) | [Jul 4, 2023](show_url) |

outputSchema.description: Playlist widget data with track listing, durations, and cover art

tools.name: get_show
tools.description: Get a Phish show with full setlist, venue, tags, and gaps. triggers: 'random show', specific dates ('Halloween 1995', '12/31/99'), or follow-up to list_shows/search. params: random=true for random; date='YYYY-MM-DD' for specific. display: Format dates as 'Jul 4, 2023'. Link tracks to web URLs (use 'url', not 'mp3_url').

date.description: Show date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for random show.

random.description: Set to true for a random show (ignores date)

outputSchema.description: Show widget data with full setlist, venue, tags, and album cover

tools.name: get_song
tools.description: Get a Phish song with performance history. triggers: 'random song' or specific song by slug. params: random=true for random; slug='song-slug' for specific. display: Format dates as 'Jul 4, 2023'. Link tracks to web URLs (use 'url', not 'mp3_url').

slug.description: Song slug (e.g., 'tweezer', 'you-enjoy-myself'). Omit for random song.

random.description: Set to true for a random song (ignores slug)

sort_by.description: Sort performances by date (default), likes, duration, or random

sort_order.description: Sort order: asc or desc (default: desc)

tools.name: get_tag
tools.description: Get shows or tracks associated with a specific tag. params: type='show' for tagged shows (e.g., costume); type='track' for tagged tracks (e.g., jamcharts). display: Link dates to show URLs, song names to track web URLs (use 'url', not 'mp3_url'). Format dates as 'Jul 4, 2023'. Example: | [Tweezer](track_url) | [Jul 4, 2023](show_url) |

type.description: Entity type to return: 'show' for tagged shows, 'track' for tagged tracks

sort_by.description: Sort by date (default), likes, duration (tracks only), or random

sort_order.description: Sort order: asc or desc (default: desc)

outputSchema.description: Tag details with associated shows or tracks

tools.name: get_tour
tools.description: Get a Phish tour with date range and show count. params: random=true for random; slug='tour-slug' for specific. follow-up: Use list_shows with tour_slug to get shows on this tour. display: Format dates as 'Jul 4, 2023'.

slug.description: Tour slug (e.g., 'fall-tour-1997', 'summer-tour-2023'). Omit for random tour.

random.description: Set to true for a random tour (ignores slug)

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Get a venue with location, show count, and date range. params: random=true for random; slug='venue-slug' for specific. follow-up: Use list_shows with venue_slug to get shows at this venue. display: Format dates as 'Jul 4, 2023'.

slug.description: Venue slug (e.g., 'madison-square-garden'). Omit for random venue.

random.description: Set to true for a random venue (ignores slug)

outputSchema.description: Venue details with location and performance history

tools.name: list_playlists
tools.description: List user-created playlists with optional sorting. follow-up: Use get_playlist with slug for full track listing. display: Link playlist names to their URLs. Example: [My Favorite Jams](url)

sort_by.description: Sort by name, likes_count (default), tracks_count, duration, updated_at, or random

tools.name: list_shows
tools.description: Browse shows by year, date range, tour, or venue. Returns shows WITHOUT setlists. params: At least one filter required. follow-up: Call get_show with date to get full setlist and audio. display: Link dates to show URLs, venues to venue URLs. Format dates as 'Jul 4, 2023'. Example: | [Jul 4, 2023](show_url) | [MSG](venue_url) |

sort_by.description: Sort by date (default), likes, duration, or random

sort_order.description: Sort order: asc (default for date) or desc

tools.name: list_songs
tools.description: List Phish songs with optional filtering and sorting. follow-up: Use get_song with slug for detailed performance history. display: Link song titles to their URLs. Example: [Tweezer](url)

song_type.description: Filter by song type: all (default), original, or cover

sort_order.description: Sort order: asc (default for name) or desc (default for times_played)

min_plays.description: Minimum number of performances (filters out rarely played songs)

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags with show and track counts. Tags categorize content: Jamcharts (notable jams), Costume, Guest, Debut, and more. follow-up: Use get_tag with a tag slug to see tagged items.

tools.name: list_tours
tools.description: List all Phish tours with optional year filtering. follow-up: Use get_tour with slug for tour details.

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: List Phish venues with optional geographic filtering. follow-up: Use get_venue with slug for venue details. display: Link venue names to their URLs. Example: [Madison Square Garden](url)

sort_order.description: Sort order: asc (default for name) or desc (default for shows_count)

tools.name: list_years
tools.description: List all years/eras when Phish performed, with show counts. Eras: 1.0 (1983-2000), 2.0 (2002-2004), 3.0 (2009-2020), 4.0 (2021+). follow-up: Use list_shows with year to see shows. display: Link years to their URLs. Example: [1995](url)

tools.name: search
tools.description: Case-insensitive substring search across shows, songs, venues, tours, tags, and playlists. note: For specific dates ('Halloween 95', 'NYE 99'), use get_show directly. follow-up: Call get_show for full setlist and audio details. display: Link dates to show URLs, titles to song URLs, names to venue URLs. Format dates as 'Jul 4, 2023'. api: https://phish.in/api/v2/swagger_doc (no key required)

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Statistical analysis: gaps (bustouts), transitions, set positions, geographic patterns, co-occurrence, and song frequency. display: Link song names to song URLs, dates to track web URLs (use 'url', not 'mp3_url'). Format dates as 'Jul 4, 2023'. Example: | [Tweezer](song_url) | 42 | [Dec 31, 1995](track_url) | api: https://phish.in/api/v2/swagger_doc (no key required)

stat_type.description: Which statistic to compute. This selects the analysis and determines which other parameters apply; each parameter below notes the stat_type(s) it affects.

song_slug.description: Song slug. Required when stat_type is 'co_occurrence' (the primary song). Optional for 'transitions' and 'set_positions' to scope results to one song. Ignored by other stat_types.

song_b_slug.description: Second song slug. Used only by 'co_occurrence': when provided, compares this song against song_slug; when omitted, returns song_slug's most common pairings.

venue_slug.description: Venue slug filter. Applies only to 'song_frequency'; ignored by other stat_types.

year.description: Filter to a single year. Applies only to 'song_frequency'. Mutually exclusive with year_range; if both are given, year takes precedence.

year_range.description: Inclusive year range as exactly two integers in ascending order: [start_year, end_year]. Applies only to 'song_frequency'. Ignored when year is provided.

tour_slug.description: Tour slug filter. Applies only to 'song_frequency'; ignored by other stat_types.

state.description: Two-letter US state code. Required when stat_type is 'geographic' and geo_type is 'never_played'. Also acts as a filter for 'song_frequency'. Ignored by other stat_types.

min_gap.description: Minimum show gap for bustout queries. Used only by 'gaps'.

min_plays.description: Minimum times played to include (default: 2). Used only by 'gaps'.

position.description: Set position filter. Used only by 'set_positions'.

set.description: Set number for opener/closer analysis (default: 1 for openers, 2 for closers). Used only by 'set_positions'.

direction.description: Transition direction (default: after). Used only by 'transitions'.

geo_type.description: Geographic analysis type (default: state_frequency). Used only by 'geographic'. 'never_played' additionally requires state.

limit.description: Max results to return (default: 25). Set this to match how many results you intend to display.

outputSchema.description: Statistical analysis result. Shape varies by stat_type (gaps, transitions, set_positions, geographic, co_occurrence, song_frequency).
